author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Regina Claudia 

Thank you so much for your encouragement and advice .
I will definitely try watching Sesame Street it sounds like a really good way to help me improve. 🙏 I actually enjoy speaking Hebrew with my coworkers even though I still speak like a toddler 😂 mostly just word by word I also often forget about words changing with gender and tense which makes it even harder for me.   But I really appreciate all the support, thank you again .
